Discard unknown properties.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    person-with-error:
        properties:
            monkey: "undefined property"
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            living: true

-- want-errors --
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties: property discarded: unknown property "monkey"

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    person-with-error:
        properties: {}
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            living:
                definition:
                    label: Living
                    value_type: boolean
                entries:
                -   value: BoolValue{true}
